name: Tobago
summary: A small island with an extraordinary concentration of rival colonial projects.
notes: Early colonies were coastal footholds amid Indigenous resistance. Dutch and Courlander settlements overlapped; repeated evacuation makes a single “number of owners” misleading. The sequence includes established administrations and substantial gaps, with very brief raids annotated.

events.title: An uncertain Spanish sighting
events.detail: Tobago is sometimes associated with Columbus’s third voyage.
events.uncertainty: The identification of the island in early voyage accounts is uncertain.

events.title: A short Spanish colony
events.detail: Spain attempted a settlement, abandoned by May.

events.title: The Spanish settlement is abandoned
events.detail: An attempted colonial foothold ended.

events.title: Nieuw Walcheren founded
events.detail: Dutch settlers established a colony near present-day Plymouth.

events.title: The first Dutch settlement lapses
events.detail: Settlement was interrupted before its revival in 1634.

events.title: Dutch settlement renewed
events.detail: Settlers returned to Nieuw Walcheren.

events.title: Spain destroys the Dutch colony
events.detail: A Spanish attack ended the Dutch foothold; no lasting Spanish government followed.
events.uncertainty: Sources variously date the attack to December 1636 or January 1637.

events.title: An English attempt
events.detail: Warwick’s colonists tried to establish an English settlement.

events.title: English settlement abandoned
events.detail: The small colony failed.

events.title: English settlers try again
events.detail: Another short-lived settlement began.

events.title: The colony fails again
events.detail: Colonists abandoned their foothold.

events.title: New Courland established
events.detail: The Duchy of Courland founded a colony at Great Courland Bay.

events.title: Dutch and Courlander colonies coexist
events.detail: A Dutch settlement made this an island of concurrent colonial projects.

events.title: The Dutch absorb New Courland
events.detail: The Courlander colony passed into Dutch hands.

events.title: English forces take the colony
events.detail: The Second Anglo-Dutch War reached Tobago.

events.title: France dislodges the English
events.detail: French forces took the colonial foothold before withdrawing.
events.uncertainty: Accounts differ between August and September; month precision follows the specialist chronology.

events.title: Dutch colonists return
events.detail: A renewed Dutch colony followed French withdrawal and the war’s end.

events.title: English attack, then evacuation
events.detail: An English raid destroyed the Dutch settlement. No enduring English administration replaced it.
events.uncertainty: Often dated 1673 in narrative histories; the source chronology dates it December 1672.

events.title: Westminster restores Dutch title
events.detail: The peace agreement restored the Dutch claim; resettlement came later.

events.title: Another Dutch colony
events.detail: The Dutch established a fortified settlement.

events.title: France destroys the colony
events.detail: D’Estrées’s expedition ended the Dutch settlement.

events.title: France acquires a disputed title
events.detail: The Nijmegen settlement awarded Tobago to France, without durable French settlement.

events.title: Courlanders return
events.detail: A renewed colony survived intermittently amid rival claims.
events.uncertainty: Settlement was interrupted in 1683–1686 and 1687; shown as an intermittent episode, not continuous island-wide control.

events.title: Courland’s colonial project ends
events.detail: The last settlements were abandoned while paper claims persisted.
events.uncertainty: Accounts give 1690 or 1693; the chart uses circa 1690.

events.title: Tobago declared neutral
events.detail: Britain and France recognized neutrality in the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle.

events.title: Britain receives Tobago
events.detail: The Treaty of Paris assigned Tobago to Britain.

events.title: Britain takes possession
events.detail: British administration and plantation development followed the treaty.

events.title: France captures Tobago
events.detail: French forces seized the island during the American Revolutionary War.

events.title: France keeps Tobago at the peace
events.detail: The peace settlement confirmed the French acquisition.

events.title: Britain captures Tobago again
events.detail: War with revolutionary France brought a new invasion.

events.title: Amiens restores France
events.detail: The peace settlement was implemented with a French handover.

events.title: Britain retakes Tobago
events.detail: Renewed war ended the short French restoration.

events.title: British sovereignty confirmed
events.detail: The Treaty of Paris made the British possession permanent.

events.title: United with Trinidad
events.detail: Tobago was joined to the larger British colony.

events.title: Independence with Trinidad
events.detail: Both islands became one independent state.
